description.value: A small 10-site provincial campground on Denman Island, reached by BC Ferries from Buckley Bay on Vancouver Island and set in old-growth Douglas fir; potable water and washrooms are on-site, but services are suspended in winter and campers must be fully self-sufficient.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record provides confirmed tags for drinking_water=yes, shower=no, toilets=yes, tents=yes, caravans=yes, cabins=no, internet_access=no, and capacity=10. The website content fetched from the BC Parks page is navigation-heavy and lacks campground-specific amenity detail, so OSM tags are the primary evidence source. The website does confirm this is a legitimate BC Parks page for Fillongley Park, corroborating the OSM website URL, but phone number and address cannot be verified from the fetched content.
concerns: Website content was navigation-only with no campground-specific amenity details; all subpages returned 404. Phone number and address could not be verified from website content. Toilet type (flush vs. pit) unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational BC Parks provincial campground with confirmed basic amenities; a legitimate overnight stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

wow_evidence: set in old-growth Douglas fir; potable water and washrooms are on-site
